headline: Cornell Green, 5-time Pro Bowl DB on Cowboys' Doomsday Defense, dies at 86
summary: Cornell Green, who never missed a game in 13 seasons while playing for the Cowboys from 1962-74, died at age 86.

headline: Chiefs mourn Allen Bailey after former NFL player found dead at age 37
summary: Allen Bailey, a former NFL player who spent the majority of his 10-year career with the Chiefs, has died at age 37.
